name: Clean Launch
summary: Swiss-clean launch film: near-black ink on pure white, one red accent that means "now", a red now-dot that travels through every shot, big tight statements of five words or fewer, every move on a 120 BPM grid.

palette.use: paper: the ground of every frame
ink: every statement, UI text, strokes; dark surfaces
red: only for "now" or "just happened" (the now-dot, a thing arriving); at most 8% of the pixels; floods the frame once per film

type.emphasis: size (1.5–1.7× inside a line, 2–5× for a hero word); the red only while a thing is arriving

banned: eyebrow or kicker labels, stacked taglines, "Introducing…", text walls, filler, decorative mono captions, fake metrics
more than 5 words on a line or 2 lines in a shot; a feature name as a headline; stock phrases (seamless, unlock, AI-powered, streamline)
serif type, italic or faked oblique
orange, amber, beige, cream, tan or sand as accent, paper or glow; purple, violet or indigo; multi-hue or purple-to-blue gradients
emoji, stock icons, AI sparkles, particles, confetti, lens flares, code rain
the red on anything that isn't happening now; red over 8% of the pixels; more than one red flood per film
bouncy overshoot except on true landings (1–7%, at most twice per film)
transition presets: glitch or RGB split, light leak, film burn, swirl, ripple, dreamy zoom, flash through white, page burn; crossfades as the default or through black
linear easing except for drift; more than about 3 easing characters in one film
